description: The on-site Marketplace, read live: game NFTs listed for ETH (companions, operatives, fighters, crates, Portal disks) and Armory weapons on the weapon market, with seller, price, fee, and whether each is buyable (not stale, not locked by a game). Only the newest tokens of each collection are scanned. Mercenaries cannot be resold; the Override Disk trades on OpenSea, not here. Read only.

collection.description: companions, operatives, fighters, crates or portal (or the contract address); or "weapons" for Armory weapons. NOT the Override Disk (Ripples' collection, trades on OpenSea) and NOT mercenaries (locked to the buyer).

recent.description: How many of the newest token ids to scan per collection (default 100, max 300).

name: marketplace_listings
